text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Police investigate allegations of foul play in the death of former government minister Davidson Ngibuini Kuguru.
- Eight more people reported dead in weekend floods.
- Former ruling Kenya African National Union party branch chairman quits and says he will join opposition. EAST AFRICAN STANDARD
- Police gun down a suspected gangster, recover four guns and 78 rounds of ammunition.
- Nairobi's Jomo Kenyatta International Airport is a haven for white-collar criminals, stealing passports and valuable items.
- Businessmen and residents of Malindi on Kenya's coast petititon government to act against powerful Italian tycoons operating a Mafia-style tax evasion and illegal immigration ring.
- Local Government Minister Francis Lotodo denies rejecting recommendations made by the presidential commission on local government.
- Five people are drowned when their car is swept away by floodwaters.
- Ruling Kenya African National Union party clarifies that only people aged 35 or less can be appointed party youth wingers. ($1=54 Kenyan Shillings)
